column1: # The `--api-server-cidr <cidr>` grammar's shared case table (app#510, #507 review-5x R1#1).
# --api-server-cidr is the apiserver endpoint the ctf-user egress NetworkPolicy allows
# (chart `networkPolicy.egress.apiServerCidr`, an `ipBlock.cidr`; passed with
# --egress-lockdown). The grammar is an IPv4 CIDR `a.b.c.d/n`: each octet 0 to 255
# written without a leading zero, n 0 to 32. IPv6 is not accepted (the apiserver
# endpoint at a stand-up is IPv4, and the chart's rule is one IPv4 ipBlock). The host
# bits are not required to be zero.
# The grammar has NO Go definition: the shell literal is the definition. The readers:
#   - Go:    internal/catalog (deploy_operator_inputs_test.go) pins the header to the
#            shell literal, and runs every row.
#   - shell: charts/ctf-user/deploy-user.sh, run row by row as
#            `--egress-lockdown --api-server-cidr <input>` by
#            scripts/check-deploy-user-ids.sh (make check-flags; CI flag-guard).
# The empty value has no row here: `--api-server-cidr ""` is the flag parser's usage
# error (exit 1), and --egress-lockdown without it is exit 2 with its own message.
# Format: the same as internal/identity/testdata/seat-cases.tsv (see its header):
# `input<TAB>accept|reject`, the closed placeholder set {LF} {U+202E} {U+00FC}
# {U+00EF}, line 1 the canonical `# pattern: ` literal. The table stays ASCII.
# The input is the value as the operator gives it, with the one exception that an
# empty value has no row (see below). A row is never dropped to make an
# implementation pass: the implementation that disagrees is the bug.
# --- baseline: what a stand-up passes (synthetic values)
# --- shape: each octet 0 to 255, the prefix 0 to 32
# --- an octet or a prefix out of range
# --- no leading zero (an octet read as octal elsewhere), no sign, no hex
# --- the shape: four octets, a slash, a prefix
a.b.c.d/32
# --- IPv6 and hostnames are not accepted
example.com/32
# --- white space and a list
# --- helm --set syntax: a `,` starts another key, `=` another assignment
10.0.0.1/32,networkPolicy.egress.enabled=false
# --- line breaks, a bidi control, a non-ASCII letter
